descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S22 「时钟或时区错了的真手机，不会改变会话什么时候结束」 A real phone with a wrong clock or time zone does not change when a session ends

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 After 12 hours idle, the physician has to sign in again with an email OTP.（UAT OAT-01 step 3；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U4 At 30 days the session hard-expires, however active it is. On day 31, access needs a new email OTP.（UAT OAT-01 step 4；UAT OAT-01 Expected；TFA-94513 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given A phone (store or TestFlight build) and a browser signed in to the same account. The phone's clock is set +13 h, then +31 d, then -2 d, then to another time zone.

When Use the app after each clock change; then age the session on the server and use it again with the clock set back

Then A fresh session stays usable whatever the device clock says. An aged session is refused whatever the device clock says. Both devices show the same state.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT 3.8 (server clock for every time-based rule) applied to U3 / U4. Any sign-out caused only by the device clock, or an aged session kept alive by setting the clock back, = Fail. The browser half runs as S07 cell (e).

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；辅助：TIME · 时间 / 老化（改时钟） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
